Class Building

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.types.building.Building
public class Building extends Card
Represents a building card that a player can acquire during the game.

Buildings are purchased by paying a food cost and grant a fixed PP value at the end of the game. They may also carry instant and interactive effects that fire when their trigger phase matches the current game phase, making them a source of ongoing bonuses throughout the match.

    • Building

      public Building(CardTypeEnum type, int id, GamePhaseEnum trigger, int age, int ppValue, int foodCost, List<CardEffectInstant> instantEffects, List<CardEffectInteractive> interactiveEffects)
      Constructs a Building from its JSON properties.
      Parameters:
      type - the card type (always CardTypeEnum.BUILDING)
      id - unique card identifier
      trigger - the game phase that gates this building's instant effects
      age - the age this building belongs to (1–3)
      ppValue - the end-game PP value of this building
      foodCost - the food cost to acquire this building
      instantEffects - instant effects carried by this building; may be null
      interactiveEffects - interactive effects carried by this building; may be null
